title: A fun and inexpensive surprise every month
text: The Allure Beauty Box is such a fun, inexpensive program I've enjoyed for a couple months so far.  I've also decided to give it as a birthday gift to a good friend of mine.  She'll know I'm thinking about her every month, and I'm sure her husband will enjoy the new perfumes, she might otherwise not try.  It's little bit of Christmas throughout the year..
label: positive
